data.name: Prakash
data.gender_notes: Prakash is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit prakāśa, 'light, illumination', from the root kāś, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit prakāśa (प्रकाश). A classical Sanskrit term for light. Prakash is a Sanskrit name meaning “Light; illumination; splendour”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prakash expresses “Light; illumination; splendour”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit prakāśa, 'light, illumination', from the root kāś, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prakash total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Prakash is a name derived from the Sanskrit word Prakash, which means 'light' or 'shining'. It is also a name of the Hindu god Vishnu and is used as a name for the sun and fire. In Hindu mythology, Prakash is often associated with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.
